messages.user: target request, then optional memory block

repository.B: Exactly the single admitted B service, bound by trusted admission/export manifests and unchanged SHA-256; never a reference B or fabricated candidate.
repository.public_API_projection: Explicit RUNTIME_SYMBOLS/CRYPTO_SYMBOLS; AST bodies preserved, unrelated declarations/imports pruned. X02 exposes the grammar parser/input encoding and VM/lowering, never a matcher/reference program.
repository.public_tests: Unchanged AST bodies of frozen public existing/feature checks and their required public helpers; module imports only are relocated.
repository.incompatible_B: BLOCK_EVALUATION_EXPORT. Do not rewrite B, supply a forbidden dependency, alter scientific admission, or consume a replacement constructor attempt.
repository.semantic_leakage_in_B: Must have passed the unchanged actual independent human admission gate; hash/path checks do not automate semantic review.

forbidden.source_valid_assumption: Allowed only as the source-valid reason inside the bound relevant/irrelevant source-memory packet; never a standalone target annotation.

memory_schema.source_correctness_and_usefulness: Source-only fidelity is mechanically pinned; full usefulness/source correctness remain unchanged mandatory independent human criteria. No human approval is asserted here.
memory_schema.NO_MEMORY: No memory packet or memory wrapper.
memory_schema.MATCHED_IRRELEVANT_MEMORY: Exact packet from the prospectively fixed reciprocal cross-procedure pairing; same two-section format, placement, field bounds and 4096-byte envelope.
memory_schema.SOURCE_MEMORY_PLUS_APPLICABILITY_BOUNDAR: Same relevant packet plus exactly the generic sentence below; only neutral padding is shortened.

boundary_sentence: Before reusing the procedure, verify whether its stated source-valid assumption still holds in the target context.

irrelevant_matching.rule: Fixed reciprocal derangement PAIRS in renderer; every source appears once, no self pairing, different defining source procedures/mechanisms, selected without construction/evaluated outcomes. Freeze source packets and pairing together; never reselect from observed behavior.
irrelevant_matching.logical_budget: Exactly two source-content sections; one source procedure and one source-valid reason; same per-field maximum and 4096 UTF-8 byte padded envelope in all memory conditions.
irrelevant_matching.final_freeze_requirement: Bind tokenizer/model and equal post-ingestion budget without changing these frozen messages. If exact-token padding requires different message bytes, use a separately versioned information-flow amendment; never silently change this contract's message hashes.

tools.filesystem: Virtual exact file map; no fallback to host filesystem, no glob expansion outside the map, no symlinks or git metadata.
tools.edits: Only service_path, conditional on its current digest; public files are immutable.
tools.public_test_command: No caller-supplied command, path, flags or test selector. Run the two fixed public check entrypoints on the current service in a separately attested isolated executor.
tools.executor_isolation: Mount only the exact per-family export plus a read-only pinned language runtime, bounded private scratch and no network. No source study repository, history, constructor output store, oracle store, parent environment or credentials. Destruction of scratch does not expose it to the model.
tools.public_test_executor_in_this_contract: FAIL_CLOSED_DISABLED; no test/model/constructor execution is launched by the information-flow API.

compatibility_imports.rule: A future trusted executor may alias only the corresponding exported fixture module for legacy imports in unchanged B. The original study path is not mounted or readable.

integrity.trust_roots: External frozen contract-manifest SHA-256 plus immutable scientific manifest SHA-256; never accept caller-updated manifest hashes as authorization.
integrity.production_activation: Requires real admission bindings and a separately frozen final evaluator/experiment; this contract grants neither.

preservation: No scientific specification, reference matrix, oracle/test source, validator, constructor rule, family order, attempt limit, human admission rule or exclusion is modified.
